official: 逗子市印鑑条例の一部改正について

sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 付議案件と審議結果

name: 印鑑条例の対象とカードの規定を追加
summary: 現行条例では、第5条第3項に「非漢字圏の外国人住民」を定めています。この議案では、本国の公的な身分証明書で氏名に漢字を使わない漢字圏の外国人住民も対象に含めます。また、第13条第2項に特定在留カードと特定特別永住者証明書を加えます。
changes: 本国の公的な身分証明書で氏名に漢字を使わない漢字圏の外国人住民を対象に含める
第13条第2項に特定在留カードと特定特別永住者証明書を加える
who: 本国の公的な身分証明書で氏名に漢字を使わない漢字圏の外国人住民
特定在留カードを持つ住民
特定特別永住者証明書を持つ住民
why: 個人番号カードを一体化した特定在留カードまたは特定特別永住者証明書の交付実施などに伴い、改正が必要なためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Adds residents to scope and card provisions to seal ordinance
en.official: Regarding the Partial Amendment to the Zushi City Seal Registration Ordinance
en.summary: Under the current ordinance, Article 5, paragraph 3 defines “foreign residents from non-kanji-using countries.” This bill also includes foreign residents from kanji-using countries whose names are not written in kanji on official identity documents issued by their home countries. It also adds specified residence cards and specified special permanent resident certificates to Article 13, paragraph 2.
changes: Includes foreign residents from kanji-using countries whose names are not written in kanji on official identity documents issued by their home countries
Adds specified residence cards and specified special permanent resident certificates to Article 13, paragraph 2
who: Foreign residents from kanji-using countries whose names are not written in kanji on official identity documents issued by their home countries
Residents with a specified residence card or a specified special permanent resident certificate
en.why: The city says the amendment is needed in connection with the implementation of issuing specified residence cards and specified special permanent resident certificates integrated with Individual Number Cards, among other things.
